mcat_description.short: Steel Buildings are factory-engineered, site-assembled structural steel building systems — including pre-engineered buildings (PEBs), industrial sheds, warehouses, and steel-framed commercial structures — supplied as complete turnkey systems or structural kits.
mcat_description.long: Steel Buildings in the Indian B2B market primarily refer to Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEBs): complete structural systems comprising hot-rolled primary steel frames, cold-formed secondary members (purlins, girts), and pre-coated metal roofing and wall cladding panels, all factory-fabricated and bolted together on-site. These structures are designed and certified to Indian Standards IS 800 (General Construction in Steel), IS 875 (Wind and Live Loads), and IS 1893 (Seismic Design), enabling compliance across India's diverse seismic and wind zones. The category spans single-storey industrial warehouses, factory sheds, aircraft hangars, cold storage facilities, multi-storey commercial buildings, and infrastructure structures such as airport terminals and metro stations. Buyers procure either as a complete turnkey EPC contract (design, fabricate, supply, erect) or as a supply-only structural kit, with clear-span widths commonly ranging up to 90 metres and structure lifespans of 25–40+ years.

market_context: The Indian Steel Buildings market is dominated by Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEBs) — factory-fabricated structural steel systems bolted on-site — which hold a 52.6% product share in the India PEB market as of 2025, with the industrial sector commanding 48.7% of end-user demand (IMARC, 2025). The India PEB market grew from USD 1.26 Billion in 2020 to USD 2.26 Billion in 2025 and is forecast to reach USD 6.46 Billion by 2034, driven by e-commerce warehousing, PLI scheme factory construction, and infrastructure development. All PEB structures in India must be designed to IS 800:2007 (General Construction in Steel), IS 875 (Wind and Live Loads), and IS 1893 (Seismic Design), with IS 800 reviewed in 2022 and further revisions expected in 2026. Key Indian manufacturers include Everest Industries, Interarch Building Products, Kirby Building Systems, Zamil Steel India, EPACK Prefab, Pennar Industries, Jindal Buildsys, and JSW Building Systems. Single-storey PEBs dominate by volume, primarily for warehouses, logistics centres, and factory sheds; multi-storey steel buildings are a growing segment for commercial and high-rise applications. Clear-span widths up to 90 metres are achievable, and PEBs deliver 20–35% cost savings versus conventional RCC construction. West India leads regionally at 30.4% market share.
